title: Meeting transcript privacy: who else reads your AI notes
description:
Your meeting transcript reaches four people, minimum - and none of that is a setting you chose.

Count them, from Microsoft's own documentation. You. The organiser, whose OneDrive the recording and transcript are filed into, even if they did not attend. The co-organisers, who get edit and share permissions. And your IT admin, who can retrieve it through Purview, Content Search or the Teams Export API. Everyone else internal who was in that meeting gets read access automatically - not on request. External and anonymous participants get nothing unless the organiser sends it.

The clock is not yours either. Teams recordings and transcripts are deleted after 120 days by default - but that is a default your admin can change, and Microsoft states plainly that the expiration feature does not enforce compliance requirements. Google Meet's notes document saves into the meeting organiser's Drive under the retention policy your organisation configured. Zoom's admins set summary retention and auto-deletion. Three vendors, one shape.

Here is the part almost nobody knows. If the organiser sets Copilot to 'Only during the meeting', it runs on temporary speech-to-text data that, in Microsoft's words, isn't saved after the meeting or event ends - and users can't access Copilot or its history afterwards. There is nothing to retrieve, because nothing was kept.

And here is the catch that matters just as much: the default tenant policy is 'On with saved transcript required', which forces 'During and after the meeting' and which Microsoft says organisers can't change. So in a default-configured organisation your organiser is not allowed to pick it. It is a thing to ask for, not a thing to assume.

To be fair to all three vendors, this design is deliberate. It is how compliance and record-keeping are meant to work, and a meeting record any participant could quietly edit would be worse.

Sources: Microsoft Learn, 'Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams meetings and events' https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/copilot-teams-transcription and 'Teams meeting recording and transcript storage and permissions' https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/tmr-meeting-recording-change and Google Meet Help, 'Take notes for me' https://support.google.com/meet/answer/14754931
